claims.claim: Amphilochius of Iconium was a Christian bishop of the city of Iconium in Cappadocia during the fourth century, born around 339/340 and dying sometime after 394.
Among his extant writings is a homily titled De recens baptizatis (On the Newly Baptized).
The Greek heading of the work identifies its audience as the "νεοφωτίστων" (newly baptized) and links it to the resurrection of the Savior Jesus Christ.
